This directory contains the unmodified QQ-TEA library source from:

https://github.com/LagrangeDev/lagrange-python/blob/572d711c5cd23e45c02c5052d4ec0833a3392cf7/lagrange/utils/crypto/tea.py

License: LGPL-2.1; see LICENSE. Copyright remains with the upstream contributors.
The source is dynamically loaded, not linked into a closed executable. You can
modify or replace tea.py and run the bridge with your modified library. No other
lagrange-python code is imported, and no login or background listener is started.
